section.title: AI Design Solution for Shopify FAQ

items.question: Is Lovart a Shopify app?
items.answer: Lovart is an AI design agent workflow for Shopify teams — not a Shopify admin plugin.

items.question: What should we upload first?
items.answer: SKU photos, brand guidelines, ads, PDP screenshots, specs, competitor URLs, and channel sizes.

items.question: Full-funnel from one brief?
items.answer: Yes — PDP, paid social, landing modules, email headers, and video keyframes.

items.question: Brand consistency?
items.answer: Brand Kit locks colors, typography, and logo rules on every generation.

items.question: Edit after generation?
items.answer: Touch Edit, Text Edit, and Edit Elements fix details without full regeneration.

items.question: Commercial usage?
items.answer: Paid plans include commercial rights. Check your plan for export limits.
